name: Sun Cleric: Dawn can be canceled to bank remaining Solar Power (#5239)
contract: Dawn 807440's DBC Attributes carry SPELL_ATTR0_NO_AURA_CANCEL (coa-dbc-viewer record --id 807440 against /home/fab/CoaServer/dbc_clientset). WorldSession::HandleCancelAuraOpcode (SpellHandler.cpp) refuses to remove any aura whose SpellInfo carries that attribute, so a player right-clicking Dawn to bank whatever Solar Power stacks remain got no response from the server at all. AscensionSunClericAuras.cpp's Remove() has no id==Dawn special case, so canceling early does not run any charge/stack cleanup beyond the aura's own removal -- nothing here depends on Dawn expiring naturally. ApplyContracts now clears SPELL_ATTR0_NO_AURA_CANCEL for id == Dawn alongside the existing dummy(0)/ProcCharges/AURA_IS_DEBUFF corrections. A native CMSG_CANCEL_AURA request against Dawn must remove it.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Fixture: Dawn requires 20 Solar Power (500149) to cast (sun_cleric_spells::OnSpellCheckCast)
Fixture: Dawn's own DBC CasterAuraSpell requires the 704396 readiness marker (normally set by AscensionSunCleric.cpp Resource(), which set_aura on 500149 bypasses)
The cancel request actually removes Dawn
